questions.stemEn: A pedigree is provided showing an X-linked recessive pattern. What is the mode of inheritance?
questions.explanationAr: الـpedigree في المصدر موصوف بأنه X-linked recessive. النمط عادةً يظهر أكثر في الذكور، مع transmission عبر carrier females، ولا يحدث father-to-son transmission.
questions.reasoningEn: The pedigree pattern described in the source is X-linked recessive.
questions.clinicalPearl: X-linked recessive disorders commonly affect males; an affected father transmits the variant to all daughters but not sons.

tts.text: A pedigree is provided showing an X-linked recessive pattern. What is the mode of inheritance? A. X-linked recessive.

questions.stemEn: An autosomal dominant pedigree shows males and females equally affected with no generation skipped. An unaffected person at the bottom marries an unaffected wife. What is their chance of having an affected baby?
questions.explanationAr: في autosomal dominant disorder، الشخص غير المصاب في pedigree المعتاد لا يحمل الـpathogenic variant المسببة للمرض، لذلك إذا تزوج شخصًا غير مصاب يكون خطر إنجاب طفل مصاب negligible ما لم توجد أسباب أخرى مثل de novo mutation أوreduced penetrance غير المذكورة في السؤال.
questions.reasoningEn: In the classic fully penetrant autosomal dominant model used by the source, an unaffected individual does not transmit the familial pathogenic variant.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: 50% ينطبق على affected heterozygous parent، وليس شخصًا غير مصاب. 25% هو pattern شائع في autosomal recessive carrier couples، و75% لا ينطبق هنا.
questions.clinicalPearl: Affected heterozygous AD parent → 50% risk per pregnancy; unaffected relative in a fully penetrant pedigree generally does not transmit the familial variant.

tts.text: An autosomal dominant pedigree shows males and females equally affected with no generation skipped. An unaffected person at the bottom marries an unaffected wife. What is their chance of having an affected baby? A. Negligible. B. Twenty-five percent. C. Fifty percent. D. Seventy-five percent.

questions.stemEn: Which statement is true regarding autosomal dominant inheritance?

options.text: Males and females are equally affected

questions.explanationAr: لأن الجين على autosome وليس sex chromosome، فالذكور والإناث يتأثرون عادةً بنفس الاحتمال. الشخص المصاب heterozygous ينقل variant إلى نحو 50% من offspring في كل حمل.
questions.reasoningEn: Autosomal dominant traits generally affect both sexes equally and can be transmitted by either parent.
questions.clinicalPearl: Vertical transmission across generations is a classic clue for autosomal dominant inheritance when penetrance is high.

tts.text: Which statement is true regarding autosomal dominant inheritance? A. Males and females are equally affected.
